<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[Naxalite–Maoist insurgency]]
**Sixteen soldiers, including a driver, [[Gadchiroli Naxal bombing|are killed]] in a landmine explosion in the [[Gadchiroli district]] of [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. Maoist insurgents are currently active in the area, leading officials to believe them to be responsible. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/01/india/india-attack-maharashtra-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;Arts and culture
*[[2019 Japanese imperial transition]]
**The [[Japanese era name|Japanese Era]] {{Nihongo|[[Reiwa]]|令和}} begins as Emperor [[Naruhito]] [[Enthronement of the Japanese Emperor|accedes]] to the [[Chrysanthemum Throne]] as the 126th [[Emperor of Japan]]. The Emperor inherits two of the [[Imperial Regalia of Japan|Three Sacred Treasures of Japan]] during a symbolic ceremony, which formalises his ascension. [https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20190430/p2a/00m/0na/023000c (''The Mainichi'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48101637 (BBC News)]

*[[Monarchy of Thailand]]
**[[Vajiralongkorn]], [[King of Thailand]], marries his head of security and mistress, General [[Suthida|Suthida Tidjai]], days before his coronation. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-king/thai-king-names-his-consort-queen-days-before-coronation-idUSKCN1S73TQ (Reuters)]
;Law and crime
*[[WikiLeaks]] founder [[Julian Assange]] is sentenced to 50 weeks in prison by a judge in the [[United Kingdom]] for breaching [[bail]] in 2012. Assange still faces possible extradition to the [[United States]] on charges of conspiracy to commit computer intrusion. [https://www.npr.org/2019/05/01/718945707/british-judge-sentences-julian-assange-to-50-weeks-in-prison (NPR)] [https://www.theguardian.com/media/2019/may/01/julian-assange-jailed-for-50-weeks-for-breaching-bail-in-2012 (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Internet censorship in Russia]] 
**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs the {{ill|Internet Sovereignty Bill|ru|Законопроект о «суверенном интернете»}} into law. The bill has drawn fierce criticism from civil society groups over fears that it would lead Russia to establish an isolated internet landscape. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2019/05/01/putin-signs-internet-isolation-bill-into-law-a65461 (''The Moscow Times'')]

;Politics and elections
* [[Fiona Onasanya]], the member of the UK Parliament for [[Peterborough (UK Parliament constituency)|Peterborough]], is removed from her position following a successful [[2019 Peterborough recall petition|recall petition]] in the wake of her conviction for [[perverting the course of justice]], becoming the first MP in the country's history to lose their seat in this manner. A [[2019 Peterborough by-election|by-election]] will be called to elect a replacement MP. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-cambridgeshire-48123355 (BBC News)]
*[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] fires [[Gavin Williamson]] as [[Secretary of State for Defence]], following the leaking of information relating to a [[National Security Council (United Kingdom)|National Security Council]] meeting, regarding the security risk posed by Chinese multinational telecommunications company [[Huawei]]. [[Secretary of State for International Development]] [[Penny Mordaunt]] is appointed the first-ever female British Defence Secretary. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/may/01/gavin-williamson-sacked-as-defence-secretary-over-huawei-leak (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/politics/penny-mordaunt-appointed-as-first-ever-female-defence-secretary-after-gavin-williamson-sacked-from-a4131876.html (''Evening Standard'')]
*The UK Parliament declares "an environment and climate emergency." [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2019/05/01/europe/uk-climate-emergency-scn-intl/index.html (CNN)]
